objective: Compute TDD and voltage THD at a PCC, select the IEEE 519 current-distortion limit row by Isc/IL, and report all limit violations with a compliance verdict.

title.en: CORE-SWAP-003 — IEEE 519 harmonic distortion compliance at the PCC
title.ru: CORE-SWAP-003 — Проверка гармонических искажений в точке общего присоединения по IEEE 519

objective.en: Compute TDD and voltage THD at a PCC, select the IEEE 519 current-distortion limit row by Isc/IL, and report all limit violations with a compliance verdict.
objective.ru: Рассчитать TDD и THD напряжения в точке общего присоединения, выбрать строку лимитов IEEE 519 по отношению Isc/IL и перечислить все нарушения с вердиктом о соответствии.

instructions.en: Use harmonic_case. Compute the short-circuit ratio Isc/IL from pcc data (Isc in amperes over max_demand_current_a) and pick the first current_limit_table row whose isc_il_below exceeds the ratio. TDD = sqrt(sum of squared harmonic currents)/IL*100; individual harmonic percentages also use IL as denominator and compare against the bucket limits by harmonic order. Voltage THD is the root-sum-square of harmonic_voltages_pct; individual voltage harmonics compare against voltage_limits.individual_pct. List violating items ('tdd'/'thd' plus harmonic orders as strings) and report the overall compliant verdict.
instructions.ru: Используйте harmonic_case. Вычислите отношение Isc/IL по данным pcc (Isc в амперах к max_demand_current_a) и выберите первую строку current_limit_table, у которой isc_il_below больше этого отношения. TDD = sqrt(суммы квадратов гармонических токов)/IL*100; индивидуальные гармоники тока также нормируются на IL и сравниваются с лимитами по диапазонам порядков. THD напряжения — корень из суммы квадратов harmonic_voltages_pct; индивидуальные гармоники напряжения сравниваются с voltage_limits.individual_pct. Перечислите нарушения ('tdd'/'thd' и порядки гармоник строками) и дайте общий вердикт compliant.

submission_schema.tdd_pct: total demand distortion in percent of IL
submission_schema.current_violations: list of violated current items: 'tdd' and/or harmonic orders as strings
submission_schema.voltage_violations: list of violated voltage items: 'thd' and/or harmonic orders as strings

hard_constraints: The limit row must be selected by the recomputed Isc/IL ratio.
TDD, voltage THD, violation lists, and the verdict must match the recomputed study within tolerance.
Unknown extra answer keys are infeasible.

metrics.name: feasible
metrics.description: Whether distortion indices, violation lists, and verdict match the recomputed study.

source_provenance.title: IEEE 519-2014 harmonic-control limits
source_provenance.notes: The executable case directly applies IEEE-519-style TDD/THD limit-table logic; the standard is cited, not redistributed.
